user.title: Connect to EveryList
user.description: Enter your EveryList server's base URL and a Personal Access Token minted from Settings → Access Tokens. The lists it's scoped to are discovered automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate EveryList
reauth_confirm.description: The configured token no longer works. Mint a new Personal Access Token — scoped to the same lists, or a different set if you want to change which lists this integration exposes — and enter it below.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the EveryList server at that URL.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected, or one of its granted lists no longer exists.
error.no_lists_granted: This token isn't scoped to any lists. Mint one with at least one list selected.

abort.already_configured: This EveryList server is already configured.
